profile_text.body:
Khan Academy is a nonprofit educational organization whose website was not fully captured by the pipeline at the time of data collection, returning only a challenge page rather than substantive content. The organization operates khanacademy.org and is verified in the site's registry as a nonprofit.

The held facts record one AI product attributed to Khan Academy: Khanmigo, categorized under Education and Research AI. It is described as an educational AI tutor, with noted considerations including student interaction data handling, COPPA compliance, and pedagogical bias.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are held for Khan Academy in the current dataset.
